products.text:
Type: one-drawer wood nightstand
Use: bedside storage, holding a lamp and books; bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: oak with wire-brushed dark finish, brass bar pull
Colors: dark brown oak, warm gold
Shape: boxy case with thick framed edges, open cubby above one drawer, long horizontal bar pull, recessed plinth base, solid and grounded, medium size
Feel: warm, refined, sturdy
Goes with: cream bedding, brass accents, warm neutrals; modern or mid-century bedrooms

Type: open bedside table
Use: bedside surface and shelf for books; bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: engineered wood, wenge laminate finish
Colors: very dark brown, near black
Shape: low rectangular box, flat top, deep top rail, single open lower shelf, no drawers, plinth sides to floor, compact and blocky
Feel: simple, practical, grounded
Goes with: white walls, light grey or beige bedding, light floors; modern or minimalist bedrooms

Type: two-drawer nightstand with metal base
Use: bedside storage, holding a lamp; bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, industrial, contemporary
Materials: solid wood with fluted drawer fronts, bronze-finish metal base and pulls
Colors: warm medium brown wood, dark bronze
Shape: rectangular case, two drawers with scalloped vertical fluting, small bar pulls, slim open metal legs with X-shaped stretcher, raised and fairly light
Feel: warm, textured, crafted
Goes with: walnut tones, black or bronze metal, cream textiles; mid-century or loft bedrooms

Type: two-drawer bedside nightstand
Use: bedside storage, holding a lamp; bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: wood with washed painted finish, brass ring pulls
Colors: dark cool navy, gold
Shape: rectangular case with paneled sides, two framed drawers, round ring pulls, corner posts with fluted tapered legs, small block feet, medium size
Feel: elegant, calm, tailored
Goes with: white or grey bedding, brass accents, light walls; classic or transitional bedrooms

Type: one-drawer side table nightstand
Use: bedside or sofa side surface with storage; bedroom, living room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: grey lacquered case, walnut veneer drawer, solid wood legs
Colors: warm grey, medium walnut brown
Shape: open box case with cubby above a curved-front drawer, four splayed round tapered legs, compact and light
Feel: airy, playful, warm
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, muted colors; mid-century or Scandinavian rooms

Type: rectangular wood dining table
Use: dining, gathering; dining room, kitchen
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: oak with walnut stain finish
Colors: warm medium brown, darker brown legs
Shape: thin rectangular top, slim apron, four angled tapered square legs, clean edges, light and open, seats six
Feel: warm, simple, timeless
Goes with: molded or upholstered chairs, white walls, brass or black accents; mid-century rooms

Type: counter-height bar table
Use: casual dining, standing or stool seating, serving; dining room, living room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, industrial
Materials: reclaimed fir wood, visible grain and joinery
Colors: weathered light brown, greyish natural wood
Shape: narrow rectangular plank top, two trestle-like leg frames with three ladder rungs, chunky square legs, tall and slender
Feel: rugged, casual, earthy
Goes with: bar stools, metal accents, whitewashed walls; farmhouse or loft rooms

Type: large trestle dining table
Use: family dining, entertaining; dining room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: solid rustic wood, distressed finish
Colors: warm weathered brown, grey undertones
Shape: long thick plank top, X-shaped trestle legs on block feet, long center stretcher, substantial and heavy, seats eight
Feel: hearty, welcoming, earthy
Goes with: cross-back chairs, benches, linen, black iron; farmhouse or cottage dining rooms

Type: round extending dining table
Use: dining, gathering; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, contemporary
Materials: wood with parquet-pattern top, birch finish
Colors: light warm natural wood, honey tan
Shape: round top splitting for an extension leaf, radiating veneer pattern, deep apron, four square splayed legs, cross stretcher base, sturdy
Feel: warm, sociable, relaxed
Goes with: white or cream chairs, linen, light walls; farmhouse or casual dining rooms

Type: dining table and chairs, set of two chairs
Use: small-space dining; kitchen, dining room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: solid pine, waxed finish
Colors: warm honey pine, golden brown
Shape: small square table on thick square legs with low stretchers, ladder-back chairs with three slats, chunky and compact
Feel: cosy, homely, simple
Goes with: dark wood floors, white cabinets, green plants; cottage or country kitchens
